latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
Fix pygwalker issue in python 3.13 due to quickjs
* feat: open in desktop by @islxyqwe in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/699
* Improve: Code readability, python linter score, FAIR4RS score by @Bruk07 in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/659
* feat:add some  chinese readme by @ikohu-66 in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/657
* Updated the bash script in test-init.sh by @vignesh1507 in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/642
* Add Reflex integration by @ObservedObserver in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/700
* Add programmatic export API by @ObservedObserver in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/701
* fix: force duckdb wheel usage by @ObservedObserver in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/719
* Add tutorial directory and a comprehensive tutorial notebook (no outputs) by @Leo-bsb in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/721
* Release 0.5.0.0 by @ObservedObserver in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/725
* fix: replace quickjs with mini-racer for Python 3.13 + Windows support by @kkollsga in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/727

## New Contributors
* @Bruk07 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/659
* @ikohu-66 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/657
* @Leo-bsb made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/721
* @kkollsga made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/pull/727

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kanaries/pygwalker/compare/0.4.9.15...0.5.0.1
